studies.Journal: The aging male : the official journal of the International Society for the Study of the Aging Male
studies.comparison_type: Prostate cancer cases versus subjects without prostate cancer

extraction_supporting_text.comparison: subjects with PCa were less likely to consume olive oil as the main culinary fat, vegetables, fruits and fish than those without.
extraction_supporting_text.design: subjects with PCa were less likely to consume olive oil as the main culinary fat, vegetables, fruits and fish than those without.
extraction_supporting_text.continent: In Europe, countries following the traditional Mediterranean Diet (MeDi), particularly Southern European countries, have lower prostate cancer (PCa) incidence and mortality compared to other European regions.
extraction_supporting_text.ethnicity: we investigated the association between the MeDi and the relative risk of PCa and tumor aggressiveness in a Spanish population.
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: consume olive oil as the main culinary fat

studies.Title: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and prostate cancer risk in Sicily: population-based case-control study.
studies.Reference: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and prostate cancer risk in Sicily: population-based case-control study.
studies.comparison_type: Olive oil consumption in prostate cancer cases versus population-based controls

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: A total of 118 PCa and 238 population-based controls were collected. Controls had significantly higher adherence to the Mediterranean diet, which was evident for several subgroups (including age groups, overweight and obese men, current smokers, alcohol intake, low and medium physical activity levels).
extraction_supporting_text.cases: A population-based case-control study has been conducted from January 2015 to December 2016 in a single institution of the municipality of Catania, southern Italy. A total of 118 PCa and 238 population-based controls were collected.
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: no statistically significant differences between cases and controls were found regarding fruit, legumes, and olive oil consumption
extraction_supporting_text.design: A population-based case-control study has been conducted
extraction_supporting_text.ethnicity: In our cohorts of Italian men
